newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden says doesn't expect better Stadshypotek bid.
newsitem.headline: Sweden says doesn't expect better Stadshypotek bid.

text.p: Swedish Finance Minister Erik Asbrink said on Thursday that commercial bank Svenska Handelsbanken had made the best bid for mortgage bank Stadshypotek and that he did not expect any higher bids.
The Swedish state owns 34 percent of Stadshypotek.
Asbrink said the sale, if it proceeds, would net the Swedish state 7.6 billion crowns.

"Svenska Handelsbanken has put forward the best offer and is prepared to pay cash for the state's shares. It is also naturally very positive that Stadshypotek personnel are guaranteed continued employment.

"The state accepts Svenska Handelsbanken's bid, but reserves the right to accept a higher bid. Given the sale process carried out by the finance ministry, however, no higher bids are expected," Asbrink said in a statement. -- Simon Haydon, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1004
